title: alchemilla vulgaris f. glacialis
intro: Alchemilla vulgaris f. glacialis, commonly known as Alpine lady's mantle, is a subspecies of the Alchemilla vulgaris plant, which is a flowering perennial plant native to mountainous regions in Europe. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, menstrual cramps, and skin irritations, due to its health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Alpine lady's mantle include reducing inflammation, protecting against oxidative stress, and promoting wound healing, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of Alchemilla vulgaris f. glacialis also exhibit antimicrobial and antiviral activities, making it a valuable resource in natural medicine.
